summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.00/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.00 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 12, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since June 1. AAA figures put the statewide average 23¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.11 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.68) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.29).
